annotations.summary: Trading Bot service API is unavailable
annotations.description: Prometheus has been unable to scrape the service API for two minutes.

annotations.summary: Service API read error rate exceeds 0.1%
annotations.description: The rolling read error rate is consuming more than the production SLO budget.

annotations.summary: Service API read p95 latency exceeds 500 ms
annotations.description: Read latency has remained above the production SLO for ten minutes.

annotations.summary: Service API metric cardinality is being folded
annotations.description: The service has exceeded its bounded HTTP metric series budget; investigate unexpected routes, methods, or status codes before telemetry quality degrades further.

rules.expr: (max(trading_bot_service_operational_snapshot_age_seconds) > 120 or max(trading_bot_service_operational_snapshot_stale) == 1 or absent(trading_bot_service_operational_snapshot_age_seconds) or absent(trading_bot_service_operational_snapshot_stale)) and on() trading_bot_service_runtime_active == 1

annotations.summary: Operational state is stale while the runtime is active
annotations.description: At least one critical operational snapshot is older than 120 seconds, stale, or missing from telemetry.

annotations.summary: Connector order circuit breaker is open
annotations.description: Order submission is blocked after repeated connector safety failures.

annotations.summary: Connector has unresolved order intent state
annotations.description: At least one order intent requires operator reconciliation before further trading.

annotations.summary: Order preflight is blocked while runtime is active
annotations.description: The deterministic safety preflight currently rejects new order submission.
